think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range/values in PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior), breaking the natural numeric ordering. 3) If such sentinel values exist, mark it as a special knob and list them; otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob.
